case: KR1 on Surplus and Diem Relay
procurement: 557 staked DIEM; each is $1 face of Venice inference credit per day; acquired separately from VVV
public_cost: Face credit $557 per day if fully staked. Purchase price of the tokens and Venice's internal consumption rate per model are not disclosed.
sale_price: KR1 sets the Surplus price. The RNS does not give a model or a multiplier. Diem Relay keeps 20% and pays suppliers 80%.
revenue: Not disclosed in dollars. 90 days to 16 Nov 2026: about 1.92 million Surplus requests and 101.5 billion tokens.
profit: October only: estimated 5.45% annualised on the fair value of the DIEM supplied. Not a cash profit and not a per-token margin.
limit: Cannot attach KR1 to an offer id. Fair value of DIEM is not in the RNS so the 5.45% cannot be turned into dollars here.

case: DashScope China fills of the same model
who: unknown sellers using Alibaba Bailian China
procurement: Bailian Beijing list still shown on 26 Nov 2026: busy ¥2/¥8 per million uncached input/output; off-peak ¥1/¥4; cache-hit ¥0.04 busy and ¥0.02 off-peak. Clock is 08:00–22:00 CST busy. USD uses CFETS parity 6.7096 and is not Alibaba's invoice currency.
public_cost: 14 fills. Surplus reference / receipt is 20.29x to 21.35x which matches the 0.0478 ask ($0.007177 / $0.033495) not a Bailian invoice.
sale_price: That ask had 3080027 trades in 24h. Volume field 274242544 micro-USD.
revenue: Seller payout is not separable from the other three sellers on the channel.
profit: Off-peak uncached card / this ask on the 14 token mixes is 18.70x to 20.76x. Busy uncached is 37.40x to 41.52x. Off-peak with every input token at the cache-hit price is 0.47x to 12.53x and 6 of the 14 mixes fall below 1. Cache does not leave every sample above the ask.
limit: No cache-token field. A pure cache-hit input token at ¥0.02 is $0.00298 about 0.42x the ask's input price. Promotional account prices were not observed.

procurement: Claude Code or another OAuth subscription the publisher attaches. Marginal token cost is not a metered API bill. Official API reference on the pricing page is $4 input and $20 output per million.
public_cost: Subscription fee of the publisher is not public. Platform keeps 20% of the ask; publisher keeps 80%.
sale_price: Live floor $0.108 / $0.54 which is 97.3% under $4 / $20. Ceiling of asks $2 / $10 which is the 50% cap. One availability slot at the floor.
revenue: Pricing page 24h telemetry for the auto-routed name: 4.2 billion input tokens of which 3.3 billion cached and 37.5 million output. That is consumer-side volume not one publisher's revenue.
profit: No publisher P&L. At the floor a publisher grosses 80% of $0.108 / $0.54 before any subscription amortisation. Net versus the subscription cannot be computed.
limit: lastRate 0.44298850574712645 is published and not defined in the public config payload. It is not used as a price.
